operation_details.item: The user uses Linear for issue tracking.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! How can I help you streamline your workflow today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'm reviewing how our team tracks projects. I use Notion for documentation.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great, Notion is solid for that. How does your team manage day-to-day updates?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We keep everyone aligned with quick messages. I use Slack for team communication.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Slack helps keep things moving. Do you have a central list of all the tools your team should be using?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, all project tools are listed in the onboarding doc.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's helpful for new hires. What about issue tracking and bug triage?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For that, I use Linear for issue tracking.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Linear is a great choice. Are you looking to improve any part of the current setup?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Mostly I want to make sure everyone follows the same workflows without overcomplicating the stack.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Keeping a lean toolchain can reduce onboarding friction.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I'll make sure the onboarding doc stays updated as we scale.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: All project tools are listed in the onboarding doc.
